# TeX transcript fixtures

Locally generated on 2026-11-03 by running the included `main.tex` and `chapter.tex`
with `lualatex -interaction=nonstopmode -no-shell-escape main.tex` and the equivalent
`xelatex` command, each in an empty temporary directory. Both exit 1 intentionally.
The first line of each `.log` records the exact engine/TeX Live version.

The inputs and original fixture content are MIT OR Apache-2.0, like Scholium.
The transcripts record engine messages and installed package metadata; no TeX installation,
font, package source or generated PDF is distributed here. They cover a nested include,
undefined control sequence, missing reference/citation, package warning/error, overfull
and underfull boxes. Do not regenerate automatically during tests.
